sections.title: Science across boundaries
sections.body:
My research brings together GIS, remote sensing, spatial modelling and long-term field experiments to understand agricultural landscapes and make scientific evidence more useful. Alongside research, I develop data infrastructures and help coordinate international collaborations linking experiments, living labs and decision-making.

I am a **Senior Scientist at the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF)** in Germany, where I work on geospatial assessments, long-term field experiments and research data infrastructure, together with scientific coordination and European project activities. I am also **Professor of Landscape Architecture at Çukurova University** in Türkiye, with research and teaching in landscape planning, GIS, remote sensing and environmental assessment.

items.name: SoilWise catalogue
items.text: SoilWise is a €6 million Horizon Europe initiative bringing together 15 European partner organisations to develop an integrated infrastructure for soil data and knowledge. The platform connects existing repositories, research networks and knowledge resources, making soil information more accessible, interoperable and reusable for researchers, practitioners and policymakers.
tags: Horizon Europe · EU Mission Soil · FAIR Data · Knowledge Management · Metadata Interoperability · Data Integration

items.name: BonaRes Repository
items.role: Scientific contributor & co-author of the repository paper
items.text: A research data infrastructure providing access to more than 2,000 soil-related data and metadata records, supporting FAIR data management and reuse in agricultural and environmental research. My contributions focus on geospatial data reuse, metadata interoperability and scientific feedback to support the repository's further development.

items.name: Integrated LTE Metadata Harmonisation Framework
items.role: Leading metadata schema development, harmonisation & scientific data reuse
items.text: An integrated metadata harmonisation framework connecting BonaRes and EJP SOIL long-term experiment inventories. It combines standardised descriptions of experimental design, agricultural management, soil properties and environmental conditions to facilitate cross-network data discovery and reuse.

items.name: Basin Scale Interactive Spatial Planning Dashboard
items.role: Dashboard development, Web GIS & spatial data integration
items.text: An interactive Web GIS dashboard developed using ArcGIS Online to explore spatial suitability for industrial development in the Büyük Menderes Basin, Türkiye.

items.name: GeoParticipate — Spatial Stakeholder Engagement Tool
items.role: Participatory GIS workflow design & application development
items.text: A spatial stakeholder engagement application developed using ArcGIS Survey123 and integrated with Web GIS dashboards. The workflow enables stakeholders to provide geographically referenced feedback, evaluate proposed development locations, identify environmental concerns and express preferences regarding planning alternatives.

items.name: LTE2LL — Linking Long-Term Field Experiments and Living Labs
items.role: My role: Concept and tool development
items.text: An emerging approach to contextualise long-term field experimental evidence for Living Labs through environmental similarity, evidence assessment, research-gap analysis and stakeholder perspectives.

sections.title: Geospatial modelling, GeoAI/ML & analytical workflows
sections.intro: Research-driven spatial methods and computational workflows I develop and implement across soil, agriculture and landscape research.

items.name: GeoAI-based agricultural suitability & vulnerability modelling
items.text: Multi-criteria spatial suitability assessment combined with Random Forest machine learning to identify priority locations for agricultural experiments under current and future climates.

items.name: Spatial representativeness & research gap mapping
items.text: PCA-based environmental similarity and spatial distance mapping to quantify the coverage of European long-term experiments across agricultural land.

items.name: AgriGullyAtlas — agricultural erosion mapping
items.text: A collaborative geospatial inventory of agricultural gullies (+200k globally) supporting erosion research, spatial assessment of soil degradation and data-driven soil conservation.

items.name: Satellite-based vegetation productivity & NPP modelling
items.text: Satellite and process-based modelling workflows for vegetation productivity and climate impacts, applied in Germany and Türkiye. Integrates environmental data and remote sensing to investigate spatial and temporal productivity patterns.

items.name: Spatial soil carbon modelling & scenario assessment
items.text: RothC and R-based modelling of soil organic carbon under alternative climate and agricultural management scenarios in Kazakhstan, supporting assessment of carbon sequestration potential and risks.

items.name: UAV-based precision agriculture & AI-computer vision tree mapping
items.text: Computer vision and centimetre-scale multispectral UAV imagery for automated citrus tree detection and orchard inventory mapping. Detection recall reached approximately 97%, with precision above 95%.

items.name: Agroclimatic zoning & climate risk mapping
items.text: GIS-based assessment of changing agroclimatic conditions and agricultural constraints, including long-term field experiment sites in Germany, supporting climate adaptation and agricultural planning.

items.name: Watershed & ecohydrological modelling
items.text: GIS-integrated catchment modelling using terrain, land use, soil and hydrological data, including SWAT applications to assess watershed processes and management impacts.

items.name: Spatial decision support & participatory landscape planning
items.text: GIS-based multi-criteria decision analysis integrating environmental indicators and stakeholder preferences to evaluate land-use alternatives and spatial trade-offs.

items.name: Integrated Soil Threat Mapping & Spatial Risk Assessment
items.role: Geospatial methodology development, spatial modelling & environmental risk assessment
items.text: Integrated geospatial analytical workflows for identifying, mapping and assessing soil threats across agricultural and natural landscapes. Combining environmental indicators, Earth observation, soil datasets and spatial modelling, these approaches enable the identification of vulnerable areas, the assessment of soil degradation patterns and the spatial prioritisation of land-management interventions.

**A new direction for AI-ready soil evidence.** Scientific coordination of an international proposal connecting long-term experiments and AI-enabled soil-health decision support. Submission does not imply funding.
**SoilWise research at EGU.** Presented work connecting scientific data infrastructures and soil data reuse.

items.title: UfU e.V. Berlin — Independent Institute for Environmental Issues
items.text: Scientific consultancy on agricultural soil carbon dynamics, integrating geospatial analysis, RothC modelling and climate scenarios. The work assesses carbon sequestration potential and the impacts of conventional and regenerative agricultural practices across major agricultural regions of Kazakhstan, supporting evidence-based climate mitigation and sustainable land management.

items.text: Scientific and technical advisory contributions focused on agricultural information systems, geospatial data integration and the reuse of scientific evidence.
